guide_no_javascript.title: VO Barna WebMCP guide — Cinema tools for AI agents
guide_no_javascript.text:
Skip to the guide
VO Barna
What’s on

WEBMCP GUIDE

VO Barna with your AI agent

Find an original-version screening around Barcelona, explore the film, and bring up its official ticket link. Your assistant can help through six tools that work alongside the page.

Browse screenings
Tool definitions (JSON)
What you can do
The six tools
Search inputs
Example workflow
Understanding the data
Access for agents
What you can do
“Find science fiction in IMAX this weekend.”
“Compare these films’ ratings and tell me who directed them.”
“Show me that screening and its ticket link.”
“Busca comedias para mañana.”
“Mostra’m les sessions de dissabte.”

Search understands film titles, actors and other searchable credits, genres, cinemas, formats and date phrases in English, Spanish and Catalan. An agent can compare returned film facts and ratings, then apply a search or open a particular screening for you to review.

Results depend on the collected programme. Examples illustrate requests you can make; they do not promise that matching screenings are available. Ticket selection and payment take place with the cinema.

The six tools

The tools are registered on the screenings page after its programme loads. Four read information. Two update the visible page and its shareable URL.

get_context
Reads information

Discover the supported cinema IDs and formats, current filters, interface language, selected film or screening, programme coverage and collection timestamps. Dates are interpreted in Europe/Madrid.

Input: {}. Use this to learn what is available and understand the user’s current view.

search_screenings
Reads information

Find upcoming sessions without changing the page. Returns paginated screenings with exact film_id and screening_id values, cinema and room, dates and times, forma
